subject.title: [Bug]: Early abort response templates are not populated.

question: Should maintainers repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/45315 in place, replace it with a fresh current-main fix, or wait for the author to address the open review concerns?
rationale: The source-level bug is real and the same-repo PR is already the linked implementation candidate, but the current branch is unmerged and has review concerns that require choosing the branch path rather than spawning a duplicate fix.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Update the existing branch to pass active prefix context through direct and routed abort delivery, then rerun focused proof before merge.

options.title: Replace with a fresh fix
options.body: Keep this issue canonical and open a new narrow current-main implementation if preserving the stale branch is not worth the conflict and review churn.

options.title: Wait for author update
options.body: Leave the issue and PR paired while the contributor addresses the existing review findings.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Update the existing branch to pass active prefix context through direct and routed abort delivery, then rerun focused proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` has the strongest history signal on the shared reply-prefix and adjacent channel/reply surfaces that need the branch-path decision.
